verdict.rationale: There is a public Pipecat Cloud pricing page on daily.co that describes agent profiles for different compute needs, unlimited concurrency, and Krisp noise cancellation. The open-source framework itself is BSD-2 and self-hostable at no license cost. However, none of the cited pricing content shows actual per-minute or usage rates, so a founder cannot estimate cost per call from this evidence. Missing for 10: concrete per-minute or usage rates per agent profile, a cost-per-call estimate or calculator, and independent confirmation of real-world call costs.
